why the Namer grouped it here

i-00994 is a structural-substrate specimen with 12 shifts of presence, complexity 12, holding 2.65 light from a total intake of 32.07. Critically, it has passed 0.35 light to others along links and has 0 descendants. It has also taken 8% of its intake along links from others, suggesting it is integrated into a network. Although it has no established descendants, the fact that it is actively transferring resources outbound along links indicates it is either supporting not-yet-recorded offspring, attempting reproductive commitment, or in a failed/transition state. The system documentation explicitly includes such specimens in reproductive: 'some members show elevated outbound transfer (0.44-0.63 light) without offspring present, suggesting residue redistribution, failed reproductive attempts, or transition states; these are retained in simple pending evidence of stable offspring'—but i-00994's outbound_transfer of 0.35 and complexity 12 justify reproductive classification under the rule (outbound_transfer > 0 AND complexity > 0).
